bluf: Netpeak is a Ukraine based growth and performance agency (B2B pipeline archetype) selling SEO, PPC, email and retention, SMM, Telegram Ads, ASO, analytics and lead generation, whose public face is Netpeak Journal, a media outlet with about 4,450 blog URLs across Ukrainian and Russian editions. It publishes steadily (97 sitemap URLs updated in 90 days) and sells ABM consultations through 24+ LinkedIn ads. The record lists no AI service, no moves and no pricing. A rival should know its house passes 3 of 4 tests, 10 of 11 clients have described work, and it sells paid social with no social pixel on its own site.
doing:
The positioning line, that it runs Netpeak Journal, a media outlet on internet marketing and online business publishing its own client cases across SEO, PPC, retention, SMM and analytics, decodes as an agency whose marketing is its publishing: the journal is the funnel, the cases the proof. The headline claim is a featured case, retention launched from zero reaching 126% payback within three months for APRO, quoted as the record quotes it.

The sold mix has no lead line; five core lines score 2. B2B & ABM: a lead generation section and case category, with LinkedIn ads offering ABM consultations, ROI and pipeline estimates. Email & CRM: email and retention cases, APRO at 126% payback and Petloc8 at 65.6% first month ROMI, plus an email academy. Paid Search: PPC cases, APRO.ua with Google Ads budget up 5x and ROAS held, and EnergyUP at +367% conversions. Paid Social: Telegram Ads and targeted ads sections, a Telegram case category and a COMFY Telegram Ads case. SEO: the meta lists SEO first, with SEO academy and link building sections, TERRAHOME at +365% ROMI and Bosch and Siemens store cases. Six lines score 1, AI search, CRO and data among them; AI automation, local, programmatic and web build score 0. Proprietary: Netpeak Journal and the Academy content series. The record lists no partners.

AI posture: no AI service is offered; the journal covers GEO and AI search shifts and describes using ChatGPT and LLMs to speed up SEO work, so AI is a tool and a topic, not a product.

Moves: none listed, nor news, case study titles or jobs beyond the journal categories. Pricing: no model listed. Conspicuously absent for a performance agency of this breadth: any office, employee count, founding date or ownership, any AI or GEO service despite 16 AI topic URLs, and any Google ad in the last 30 days (22 in the library, last shown 2026-07-22).
clients:
The ICP is mixed and three verticals are listed: Ecommerce, Beauty & cosmetics and Moving services. The home market is Ukraine, with the journal published in Ukrainian and Russian editions and the case pages sitting under the ru path; no office is listed.

The needs read holds 11 clients, all from case study categories, with 10 observed and 1 name only, a book that is mostly described work. The mix splits four ways: local and lead generation 0.3, organic demand 0.3, CRM and owned audiences 0.2 and paid performance 0.2. APRO, Petloc8 and COMFY sit in the general cases category, coded leads, with the APRO retention payback and the COMFY Telegram Ads case described in the capability notes. Китайский привет and A's Laboratory come from the email marketing case category, CRM and owned audiences. TERRAHOME, Shopping-Kobolde and the Bosch and Siemens official store come from the SEO case category, organic demand, TERRAHOME with +365% ROMI; EnergyUP and H2H Movers come from the PPC case category, paid performance, EnergyUP at +367% conversions. Checkbox Group is the one name only, from the homepage, its need inferred from the sold mix.

One client is shared: EnergyUP also sits on the books of search-laboratory and found.

What the base needs next: the read places Netpeak best for KJ1, the click is being replaced by the citation, and KJ2, ads inside AI answers, both resting on a Paid Search line and an AI Search line that scores only 1. It is likely, moderate confidence, that these ecommerce and service clients next ask for the AI search visibility the agency writes about but does not sell, and very likely that the PPC and Telegram hours are the ones platform automation absorbs first, the KJ6 and KJ4 exposures.
house: Say and do: four lines tested, three corroborated. Paid Search: it runs its own Google ads, 22 in the Transparency Center, though 0 in the last 30 days and last shown 2026-07-22. LinkedIn advertising: 24+ ads of its own, 9 company page and 15 thought leader ads by staff, a floor since 88 match the name query; one reads "Розрахуйте потенційну рентабельність ABM на основі показників вашого бізнесу", an ABM ROI estimate offer. Publishing cadence: 97 sitemap URLs updated in 90 days and 426 in 365, from 4487 in total, with 16 AI topic URLs. Paid Social is contradicted: it sells paid social and Telegram Ads and runs no social ad pixel on its own site, the one gap the Radar lists. No llms.txt, no AI crawlers blocked. The tag stack shows gtm and ga4, with no CMS detected, no test tools and no ABM stack on a site that sells ABM. Meta and TikTok: the record is silent.
market:
The Horus read scores Netpeak at 2.5 on the tailwind index, Neutral band, percentile 25. It is best placed for KJ1, the click is being replaced by the citation (net 0.164: AI Search / GEO and Paid Search positive, SEO negative), and KJ2, ads inside AI answers (net 0.164, Paid Search and AI Search / GEO). It is most exposed to KJ6, the agency middle is being hollowed out (net -0.253, Paid Search, Paid Social and SEO), and KJ4, the platforms are absorbing the execution layer (net -0.109). Best scenario fit: The Walled Oasis at 38/100. P moves: making P7, partial on P1, P4 and P6, unknown on P5, absent on P2 and P8, not applicable on P3.

The Monsoon read: index 41.9, Breeze band, percentile 12, migration 32.9 against displacement 50.9, inferred, with a destination term subtracting 15 points. The verdict says SEO (11) and Paid Search (8) carry the most movable hours and the shore split sends 75% to South and Southeast Asia and 15% to Eastern Europe; no hub office or onshore claim is listed.
openings:
Lead with the paid social contradiction: Netpeak sells paid social and Telegram Ads and cites a COMFY case, while its own site runs no social ad pixel. A rival that runs pixels and visible social campaigns on its own house likely, moderate confidence, wins the social credibility test with ecommerce buyers. Falsifier: a Meta or TikTok pixel appearing on netpeak.net.

The AI gap is the wider opening: the journal writes about GEO and AI search and describes using ChatGPT and LLMs for SEO, yet no AI service is offered and no audited AI visibility product shows (P1 partial), so a rival selling audited AI visibility to its ecommerce base leads with a number it has only written about. Paid media runs without first party data, creative volume or measurement depth showing (P4 partial) and with no test of ads inside assistants (P8 absent): the inputs the platforms consume are the pitch against its PPC line, most exposed to KJ6.

EnergyUP is the client to contest, shared with search-laboratory and found. With no public pricing model (P5 unknown), a transparent outcome priced offer is a conversation it cannot have in public, low confidence on price sensitivity given displacement 50.9.
watch: Indicator I8, holdco Q3 organic growth, headcount and pricing model disclosures, next reading October 2026: output or outcome pricing at a top five holdco would sharpen the KJ6 exposure of a performance agency with no pricing model.

Indicator I2, Alphabet Q3 2026 search growth and AI Mode ad disclosures, next reading late October 2026: search and other growth below 10% flags cannibalization of the SEO and PPC hours it sells, above 15% with AI Mode ads live confirms S1.

Indicator I10, Reddit US daily users versus search referral volatility, next reading late October 2026: US DAUq growth at or below 5% alongside AI Mode growth confirms the UGC starvation risk under KJ1.
Indicator I3, OpenAI ad run rate disclosures and CPM trend, rolling: the next milestone ($2B) and pricing below $20 CPM would set the terms for the ads inside assistants test it has not run.

Follow up the Google ads record, 22 in the library and none shown since 2026-07-22: a restart would keep the paid search corroboration, a continued silence would turn it into a second contradiction at the next compile.
